fighting-style.name: Fighting Style
fighting-style.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty.

archery.name: Archery
archery.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

defense.name: Defense
defense.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

dueling.name: Dueling
dueling.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

second-wind.name: Second Wind
second-wind.description: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level.

action-surge-1.name: Action Surge
action-surge-1.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action.

actions.name: Action Surge
actions.effect: Take one additional action on your turn

martial-archetype.name: Martial Archetype
martial-archetype.description: At 3rd level, you choose an archetype that you strive to emulate in your combat styles and techniques.

champion.name: Champion
champion.description: The archetypal Champion focuses on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection.

extra-attack-1.name: Extra Attack
extra-attack-1.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

great-weapon-master.name: Great Weapon Master
great-weapon-master.description: You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage, letting its momentum empower your strikes.

actions.name: Power Attack
actions.effect: Before making a melee attack with a heavy weapon, take -5 to attack roll for +10 damage

mechanics.special: When you score a critical hit or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a melee weapon attack, you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.description: You have inexplicable luck that seems to kick in at just the right moment.

actions.name: Lucky
actions.effect: Reroll an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw
